scope: Primary-source verification for subsequent native website-grant resume; no product implementation

observed.Vortex_NXMUrl: Official mod-file URI constructor/parser establishes nxm scheme, game host, /mods/{mod}/files/{file} identity and key/expires/user_id query fields. Its property comments describe the account identity and expiry. Collections, OAuth, premium/view links are distinct forms, not generic download authorization.
observed.node_Nexus_getDownloadURLs: Pinned official client documents free-account website-generated keys from Download with Manager. It appends key and expires to the fixed mod/file download_link route only when both are supplied; user_id is not a link-route query field.

implementation_inferences: Native grant resume can preserve the existing typed account/source/expiry resolver binding and accept only the mod-file authorization subset. Strict duplicate/ID/type/resource limits are our admission policy, not an assertion that Vortex rejects every corresponding shape.

The official parser also accepts extra query parameters and less-strict decimal parsing; do not silently claim whole NXM parity. No collection/OAuth/premium/view URI is a substitute for a website-issued bound file grant.
Each chosen free-account source requires its own applicable website authorization; an acquisition group does not manufacture or generalize grants.
not_verified: Native queued grant storage/resume/consume-once worker integration
